name: unusual_whales
text:
America’s economy faces a growing problem: not enough people, per Business Insider.

The US population grew by just 1.8 million people in 2025, down from 3.2 million the year before, per the Census Bureau. Immigration accounted for the entire slowdown. 

Net immigration is projected to fall to about 321,000 this year, far below the low-immigration scenario Census previously modeled. 

Births are barely outpacing deaths, at about half a million a year, less than half of pre-pandemic levels.
